_catalog_note: Beastman tier - not in setting-lore §5.2; demographics from ax_domains_of_chaos.xml (catalog 5.3). Naming/totemic flavor only.
sub_palette: troll (Kazhur regressed - deep slow groans, long vowels)
homeland: no fixed homeland (deep caves, mires, and boulder-fields)

branch.regression: deep slow groans (vowels lengthen to oo/uu, consonants soften to deep voiced g/d/b/m, drawn-out, suffix -oom/-rugg/-uum)
branch.nature: huge, dim, regenerating; ponderous and ever-hungry; the simplest concepts
branch.model: Kazhur rotted into a troll's slow deep groan

_note: Beastman culture: TROLLS, huge dim regenerating brutes - Kazhur rotted into deep slow groans and drawn-out vowels (qatal 'kill' -> Gadool-uum). The simplest concepts of any beastman. ALWAYS CHAOTIC; totemic shamanism (race-totem the Stone-Belly / the Ever-Mending). Trolls especially demonize fire (their bane). Deity-morphs Gul- prefixed. Mechanically stripped (catalog 5.3).

phonology.palette: Troll (Kazhur, slow-groan regression): vowels lengthen to oo/uu, consonants soften to deep voiced g/d/b/m, drawn-out, suffixes -oom/-rugg/-uum; ponderous, deep, slow.
phonology.phonotactics: long-vowel CVVC; deep voiced codas; slow heavy stress.

morphology.naming_marker: named slowly by the gashoob; a deep groan-name.

title_ladder._note: Mapped to the ACKS 7 civ tiers (the shared system; not a perfect fit) by how many clanholds a leader rules - barony = chief of one clanhold (lowest governing leader), empire = the great horde-lord over hundreds (rare for trolls, who are few and scattered). thrall/warrior are NOT governing roles (see non_governing_ranks).
title_ladder.government: clanhold / troll-band - small, scattered (mapped to the civ 7-tier ladder by clanholds ruled)

march.scope: war-chief of a frontier / raiding clanhold

empire.scope: the great horde-lord over hundreds of clanholds

religion._note: CHAOTIC, totemic, and simple. Race-totem the Stone-Belly / the Ever-Mending (trolls regenerate). The Gashoob groans to the totem and the Gul-spirits in the deep cave; foremost Gul-Waqidu the Devouring-Dark (the endless gut). Trolls demonize Tarul the Burning-Eye above all - FIRE stops their mending, and is their dread.

demonized.Tulrius (the sun, fire): Tarul the Burning-Eye (FIRE, the troll's bane - dreaded above all)

religion.shaman_rites: slow groan-chants in the deep cave; the gnawing of bones; the dread and shunning of fire.

holy_symbol_motifs.Stone-Belly: a great round gut over a boulder

banks_patterns.war_bands: the groan-named bands: 'the Stone-Bellies', 'the Bone-grinders', 'the Boulder-throws of [chief]'
banks_patterns.lairs_dungeons: deep caves, mires, and boulder-fields: 'the Deep-cave of [band]', 'the Bone-grind of [chief]', 'the Boulder-deep of [name]'
